_readme: Threshold calibration fixtures for CC-13 duplicate complaint detection.
The production data cannot calibrate this. Measured 2026-09-20 on all 15
live complaints: same-location pairs reached a maximum similarity of 0.144
and were not actually duplicates ('Urgent Maintenance' vs 'Board Not
working properly' are different faults in one room), while the highest
similarity overall, 0.857, was between two junk placeholder titles in
different rooms. There are no real duplicates to learn from.
So pairs are labelled here instead. 'duplicate' pairs describe the same
physical fault in different words; 'distinct' pairs are different faults
that a naive text match might confuse. The threshold must separate them.
Location is filtered in SQL before similarity is considered, so every pair
here is assumed to be in the same room.
